title: UNICEF's babyproofing page also says babies sleep on the back, on a firm mattress, with nothing soft
summary: UNICEF's babyproofing page says to place babies on their backs to sleep, on a firm mattress, with no blankets, pillows, or toys.
body: UNICEF's page on babyproofing a home, a source outside the US government, tells caregivers to place babies to sleep on their backs, on a firm mattress, with no blankets, pillows, or toys. It groups that line with choking and suffocation, and it says cords and soft bedding can strangle or suffocate. The wording is a paraphrase of UNICEF Parenting, which is not a CC BY page. It is not the US CDC list, and it does not replace a national health service's own page. The US campaign's extra points, such as room sharing and swaddling, are not what this sentence adds.
